 Medium

 Print Filmmaker and actor Tyler Perry has purchased a mansion in Puerto Rico for more than $30 million, weeks after revealing that he plans to relocate to the island and reduce his workload to spend more time with his son. The purchase comes as the entertainment mogul prepares for a new chapter in his personal and professional life. According to People, which confirmed the purchase, Perry has closed the deal on a 14,475-square-foot property spread across nearly 1.4 acres. Inside Tyler Perry’s $30 million Puerto Rico mansion
 Built in 2021, the property is located inside a gated community and has five bedrooms and 10 bathrooms. Its amenities include a private movie theatre, an open-plan kitchen, a swimming pool and a gym. The size and facilities of the residence offer Perry space to live comfortably while continuing his work in the entertainment industry. According to TMZ, sources familiar with his plans say he intends to establish a production office in Puerto Rico and shoot projects on the island. This suggests that his relocation will not mark a complete departure from filmmaking. Tyler Perry plans to slow down and spend more time with his son
 The mansion purchase follows Perry’s September appearance on Today with Jenna & Sheinelle, where he spoke about moving to Puerto Rico at the beginning of 2027. During the interview, he confirmed that he intended to reduce his workload considerably. “Yep, moving to Puerto Rico at the top of the year, and I’m pulling back a whole lot,” Perry said, explaining that getting older had encouraged him to reconsider his priorities. He added that he wanted to slow down, spend more time with his son and appreciate life beyond his demanding professional schedule. Perry, 57, shares his 11-year-old son, Aman, with his former partner, model and activist Gelila Bekele. The two were in a relationship from 2009 to 2020. Although Perry has spoken about scaling back his work, his reported plans to establish a production office in Puerto Rico indicate that he intends to remain involved in filmmaking and other entertainment projects. Tyler Perry lists his Beverly Hills mansion for $57 million
 The Puerto Rico purchase comes at a time when Perry is also making changes to his property portfolio. In September 2026, he listed his Beverly Hills mansion for $57 million, according to The Wall Street Journal. The sprawling estate measures approximately 24,592 square feet and sits on 22.5 acres within a gated community. Perry purchased the property for $4.3 million in 2004 and completed the construction of the mansion in 2012. The estate is also known for its connection to Prince Harry and Meghan Markle, who stayed there in 2020 after stepping away from their senior royal duties and relocating from the United Kingdom. Perry provided the couple with a place to stay as they settled into their new lives in the United States. Perry also owns property in Atlanta, close to Tyler Perry Studios, his expansive production facility built on a former military base. His real estate holdings have included a private island in the Bahamas and a home in Jackson, Wyoming, which was listed for $39.5 million in June 2026, according to The Wall Street Journal, as cited by People. Perry has built a career as an actor, writer, director and producer, becoming widely known for creating the Madea character and producing films, television shows and stage productions. His Atlanta-based studio has also become a major part of his entertainment business.
